content: मुष्टिकः [मुष्टिर्मोषणं प्रयोजनमस्य कन्] .²1 A goldsmith. .²2 A particular position of the hands. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a demon. .{@-कम्@} A pugilistic encounter, fisticuffs. .{@-काः@} ({%<ab>pl.</ab>%}) <ab>N.</ab> of an outcast race (the {%Dombas%}); श्वमांसनियताहारा मुष्टिका नाम निर्घृणाः <ls>Rām. 1. 59. 19</ls>.
